viewer: Hindi-speaking viewers who watched ep1 or land cold, scrolling alone at night
hook: मैं किनारे पर रुका रहा, और पानी के पार से कोई चलकर आने लगा।
payoff: The walker is upside down under the water; he stays silent and the lake answers in his own voice anyway.
belief_label: invented village saying inside a fiction; not a real belief or safety advice
sources: Original story (Doomsday Horror). Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS, sound synthesized in code.

series.next_hook: झील के पास अब मेरी आवाज़ थी, और वह किसे बुलाएगी?

story.setup: He stays on the shore while the boat sits lit at the bank and something walks across the lake toward him.

rule_or_clue.text: नाव की आवाज़ का जवाब मत दो
rule_or_clue.line: नाव की आवाज़ का जवाब मत दो

rule_or_clue.text: he has called his brother for three nights
rule_or_clue.line: तीन रात से मैं यहाँ खड़ा पुकारता रहा

escalation.text: the walker with the brother's lean and no ripples
his full name is called from the water
escalation.line: मेरा पूरा नाम पानी से आया

escalation.text: a white face looks up from under the surface
escalation.line: एक सफ़ेद चेहरा मुझे देखने लगा

false_relief.text: he thinks he has won by staying silent
false_relief.line: मुझे लगा कि मैं जीत गया

twist.text: he stays silent and the lake answers in his own voice anyway
twist.line: झील से मेरी अपनी आवाज़ ने जवाब दे दिया
twist.how: The hook says someone walks toward him across the lake: the walker was the lake fishing for his one word, and when he refuses, it takes his voice anyway.

story.part_question: What is walking toward him across the water?

part_payoff.text: the walker is under the water, upside down
part_payoff.line: पानी के नीचे चल रहा है

ending_image.text: a wave with no wind soaks him and shoves him up the bank like many small hands

callback.text: the many who walked toward him return as the many small hands that shove him out
callback.line: बहुत सारे छोटे हाथ मुझे बाहर धकेल रहे हों

first_seen.line: एक सफ़ेद चेहरा मुझे देखने लगा

new_facts: The walker is under the water and inverted
The lake can answer in the narrator's voice
Many small hands shove him out of the water
